import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path('/Users/nakashimahikaru/RustroverProjects/implied-vol')
TRIAL = Path('/tmp/implied-vol-readme-20261004')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('comparison', REPO/'benches/compare_solvers.py')
comparison = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(comparison)
comparison.SOLVERS = ('hybrid', 'jaeckel', 'flashiv', 'experimental')
paths = list((TRIAL/'target/release/deps').glob('implied_black_vol_paths-*'))
paths = [p for p in paths if p.is_file() and os.access(p, os.X_OK) and p.suffix != '.d']
assert len(paths) == 1, paths
executable = paths[0].resolve()

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

sources = sorted(set(REPO.glob('src/**/*.rs')) | set(REPO.glob('benches/**/*.rs')) |
                 {REPO/'Cargo.toml', REPO/'Cargo.lock', REPO/'.cargo/config.toml',
                  REPO/'benches/compare_solvers.py'})
source_before = {str(p.relative_to(REPO)): digest(p) for p in sources}
initial_hash = digest(executable)
samples = []
invocations = []
iterations, rounds, blocks = 200000, 3, 8
started = time.monotonic()
orders = []
for block in range(blocks):
    offset = block % len(comparison.SOLVERS)
    order = comparison.SOLVERS[offset:] + comparison.SOLVERS[:offset]
    if block >= len(comparison.SOLVERS):
        order = tuple(reversed(order))
    orders.append(order)
    for position, solver in enumerate(order):
        command = [str(executable), str(iterations), str(rounds), '--solver', solver]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        samples.extend(comparison.parse_samples(result.stdout, solver, rounds, block, position))
        invocations.append({'block': block, 'position': position, 'solver': solver, 'command': command})
    print(f'Completed rotating block {block+1}/{blocks}', flush=True)
elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
for solver in comparison.SOLVERS:
    assert Counter(order.index(solver) for order in orders) == Counter({i: 2 for i in range(4)})
assert digest(executable) == initial_hash
source_after = {str(p.relative_to(REPO)): digest(p) for p in sources}
assert source_before == source_after
summary = []
for case in comparison.CASES:
    medians = {}
    for solver in comparison.SOLVERS:
        rows = [r for r in samples if r['case'] == case and r['solver'] == solver]
        assert len(rows) == rounds*blocks
        assert len({float(r['checksum']) for r in rows}) == 1
        medians[solver] = statistics.median(r['ns_per_call'] for r in rows)
    for solver in comparison.SOLVERS:
        rows = [r for r in samples if r['case'] == case and r['solver'] == solver]
        summary.append({
            'case': case, 'solver': solver, 'median_ns_per_call': medians[solver],
            'time_change_vs_hybrid_percent': 100*(medians[solver]/medians['hybrid']-1),
            'samples': len(rows), 'checksum': rows[0]['checksum'],
            'block_medians_ns_per_call': [statistics.median(r['ns_per_call'] for r in rows if r['block']==b) for b in range(blocks)],
        })
runner = Path(__file__)
record = {
    'date': '2026-10-04',
    'revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip(),
    'cpu': subprocess.check_output(['sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string'], text=True).strip(),
    'machine': platform.platform(),
    'rustc': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '-Vv'], cwd=REPO, text=True).strip(),
    'build': {'features': 'flashiv,experimental', 'fma': False, 'cxx_bench': False,
              'rustflags': '-C target-cpu=native', 'profile': 'bench, lto=true',
              'SDKROOT': '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX15.2.sdk',
              'command': 'cargo bench --bench implied_black_vol_paths --no-run --features flashiv,experimental --message-format=json',
              'target_directory': str(TRIAL/'target')},
    'iterations': iterations, 'rounds': rounds, 'blocks': blocks,
    'samples_per_solver_per_case': rounds*blocks,
    'measurement_seconds': elapsed,
    'executable': {'path': str(executable), 'sha256_before': initial_hash, 'sha256_after': digest(executable)},
    'source_sha256': source_before, 'source_unchanged': source_before == source_after,
    'cases': list(comparison.CASES), 'solvers': list(comparison.SOLVERS),
    'order': 'Four cyclic solver rotations, followed by their four reversed rotations; all solvers occupy each position twice.',
    'cpu_policy': 'No other build, proof or numerical-reference jobs were running during measurements.',
    'caveat': 'Warm single-threaded synthetic workloads on this M1 host, no CPU affinity. Prices and builders are prepared before timing. Preflight checks finite positive output, not root accuracy. Different solver contracts permit different cross-solver checksums; each solver checksum is stable. No global fast-math or implicit FMA contraction.',
    'runner': {'sha256': digest(runner), 'source': runner.read_text(),
               'parser': 'benches/compare_solvers.py::parse_samples with the four-solver tuple substituted'},
    'invocations': invocations, 'summary': summary, 'samples': samples,
}
destination = REPO/'docs/local-solvers-2026-10-04.json'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(f'Saved {destination}', flush=True)
for case in ('mixed_normalised', 'mixed_full'):
    print(case, [(r['solver'], round(r['median_ns_per_call'],3), round(r['time_change_vs_hybrid_percent'],3)) for r in summary if r['case']==case], flush=True)
